title: SAP security advisory – August 2026 monthly rollup (AV26-798)
description: As of August 11, 2026, SAP is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
SAP Commerce Cloud (Data Hub Adapter)
	Versions COM_CLOUD 2211 and 2211-JDK21

SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence
	Versions XMII 15.4, 15.5, MII_ADMIN 15.4 and 15.5

SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence
	Version MII 15.4, 15.5

SAP Change and Transport System Attach Tool (ctsattach)
	Version CTS_UPLOAD_CLT 1

SAP ABAP Developer Tools
	Versions AP_BASIS 750, SAP_BASIS 751, SAP_BASIS 752, SAP_BASIS 753, SAP_BASIS 754, SAP_BASIS 755, SAP_BASIS 756, SAP_BASIS 757, SAP_BASIS 758, SAP_BASIS 816 and SAP_BASIS 918, SAP_BASIS 920
Versions AP_BASIS 750, SAP_BASIS 751, SAP_BASIS 752, SAP_BASIS 753, SAP_BASIS 754, SAP_BASIS 755, SAP_BASIS 756, SAP_BASIS 757, SAP_BASIS 758, SAP_BASIS 816 and SAP_BASIS 918, SAP_BASIS 920

SAP Commerce Cloud
	Versions OM_CLOUD 2211, 2211-JDK21 and DHUB_CLOUD 2211, 2211-JDK21

SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform (Central Management Server)
	Versions AP_BASIS 750, SAP_BASIS 751, SAP_BASIS 752, SAP_BASIS 753, SAP_BASIS 754, SAP_BASIS 755, SAP_BASIS 756, SAP_BASIS 757, SAP_BASIS 758, SAP_BASIS 816, SAP_BASIS 918, SAP_BASIS 920, ENTERPRISE 430, 2025 and 2027

Versions AP_BASIS 750, SAP_BASIS 751, SAP_BASIS 752, SAP_BASIS 753, SAP_BASIS 754, SAP_BASIS 755, SAP_BASIS 756, SAP_BASIS 757, SAP_BASIS 758, SAP_BASIS 816, SAP_BASIS 918, SAP_BASIS 920, ENTERPRISE 430, 2025 and 2027

SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence
	Versions MII 15.4 and 15.5
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
